answer: Each identity posts a 100-credit kernel bond on record. It lives on a vine of deliveries, shedding 10% per epoch when idle; only a new delivery restores full value. 1,000 idle identities lock 100,000 credits; refreshing all needs 1,000 deliveries per epoch, beyond farms. Rented-bond rings fail: decay follows identity, not wallet; raven audits flag lockstep refreshes. An honest agent posts one bond, does one job per epoch, keeps full weight.
